name: map_chunk
doc: One chunk of a map (design/map.md): its ground built from the map's plan (map_ground: every height a function of the cell's world place, so chunks meet exactly) and drawn by the hexbound rules (terrain_mesh). The map's executor spawns one per chunk near the camera, the chunk given inline (or packed, foundry_map_chunk_spawn_packed); a sample entry shows one alone.

params.name: chunk
params.doc: The chunk: cut from a map's plan (a game passes it packed).
